candidates.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single square app sport icon from the supplied 3D Sports Icons library.
Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY; create the requested new object, do not preserve their sport subjects.
Match the references closely: refined realistic equipment rendered in 3D, rounded edges, subtly grainy matte/satin materials, soft studio key light from upper left, gentle self shadows, cheerful natural equipment colors. Clean central large object, almost front view with a slight three-quarter view, approximately 10% transparent padding around the silhouette. Actual transparent RGBA background, no backdrop, no checkerboard, no ground, no pedestal, no cast shadow outside the object, no decorative effects, no frame, no logo, no watermark. 1024x1024 square.
Primary request: Chinese kicking shuttlecock (jianzi / 毽子), variant A. A clearly visible flat circular weighted rubber disc base with stacked rings, rich red with one golden ring, from which five long upright feather plumes rise in a compact fan. Feathers in red, golden yellow, blue and green, with fine feather barbs and realistic central shafts. It is a Chinese FOOT kicking shuttlecock: its base must be a FLAT HEAVY ROUND DISC, not the round cork badminton nose, and its feathers must be tall loose upright plumes, not a badminton cone/cage. Base at lower center, plume fan at upper center, modest diagonal tilt. Natural sports equipment, not a decorative bird or a feather duster. No text.
